description: Measured 2026-11-07: ring centred directly above the PX4 (2.8 cm higher; not used by the planar model). Opposite-sensor spacing S1-S5 7.8 cm, S3-S7 7.8 cm, S2-S6 6.7 cm, S4-S0 6.7 cm, so radius 3.9 cm (front/back/left/right) and 3.35 cm (diagonals). Sensor headings, zone order, FOV and distance model are still the uncalibrated defaults.
